nom: Clinique Smart Clinical Repair AM/PM Retinoid Balm

avis.texte: A non-smoker, but with lip lines, I wanted to try something to help minimize them. This seems to work! I've used 3 tubes to date, and will keep using it as I believe it improves the ruduction of my lip lines with continued use.

I have been a Clinique user since is about 15 or so, 45 now. This product is wonderful, im about maybe 2 -3 weeks into use and im noticing a difference in those droops you get by your nasal folds and around the mouth. I can imagine that with prolonged use, as with any retinol products, that this will make a hige difference. I do also use the serum and moisturizer from the Smart line as well.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I would highly recommend this for smoothing out fine lines of specially around lips. It has no smell which was pleasant so it did not clash with other products. It can be applied very smoothly and it's texture is like silk.
Paid the money for this product. Used it to the end. Couldn't see a single sign of improvement or change.
I got this product to help minimize the forehead wrinkles. I have only used for a short period of time, but they already look reduced.
I just added this to my smart clinical repair set. I like how easy it is to apply. A little goes a long way. Will update after more time has passed.

This is one product that works for me. I stopped for a few weeks (I had misplaced my last Clinique shipment) and the results were obvious. Actually, I see better results with this than the serum on the lines around my mouth. I'm not sure about quitting the serum. At 77 I can use all the help I can get. I use all the "purple" Clinique products.
I'm obsessed with this but it is insanely small! The size of a chapstick. For over $30 I will look for something more affordable that is similar.
I bought this several months ago after reading the great reviews. I have been using it daily on the mild creases on my forehead but have found absolutely no results whatsoever. None. Waste of money.

This retinoid balm applies very smoothly. I pat it into the wrinkles after drawing over them. I like how easily it applies without any mess. After a few weeks of use I do notice my wrinkles fading, especially around my mouth. I am 60.

avis.titre: Works well, but packaging is not good
avis.texte: I've been using this on my forehead lines for a few months and have been seeing some results. However, there is as much product that can be applied as stuck in the tube. Once you use all the product and cannot twist anymore up. There is a ton still left in the tube. I've been digging it out either my fingernail, but what a waste! Either add a way to push up the product in the tube or put it in a pot.

I have an Italian scowl and at 60 years old, I thought I'd try this little stick... It did help a bit and so I tried it on a few more fine lines around my smile on my cheeks. But then began to notice dark ugly lines wherever I applied this stuff... No bueno! Stopped using and the ugly darkness left the building... God is all I need, not this stuff!
This is very moisturizing and soft. I can even use it on my lips. It acts slow and securely. It would be too much for oily skin.

Yall, if you are not giving this product 6 months to work then you are definitely gonna be disappointed because ALL retinol products need time.. a lot of time. It doesn't work in 2 weeks so don't expect it too.. If someone says they saw great results in 2 weeks its not the retinol it is the fact that they had dryer skin and started using this and the higher moisture content made a difference.. I have been using this for a year regularly and it definitely has made a difference. Young people want to apply it a few times and if they don't see quick results they automatically say oh no, this doesn't do anything for me!! It will… give it time.

avis.titre: It's ok, hard to tell... Let me explain
avis.texte: I use this balm at the end of my skin care routine to really hyper focus on problem areas like my 11s, forehead wrinkles, and the find lines on the sides of cheeks by my mouth. It seems to work ok but I got it in December for Christmas and I'm already out by the time I wrote this on February 5th. I only use it 1x a day and don't go ham with it so having it only last about a month is a disappointment. It's also not long enough to really tell if it's beneficial. I might switch to a different brand/balm but keep some of my other Clinique staples in rotation.

I love this balm because it can be used not just for the face but also for the lips. I buy several and keep one in my purse so I can apply it on my lips and under my eyes during the winter to help hydrate throughout the day. It isn't greasy at all so it doesn't interfere with my makeup. It is just this great hidden gem that I won't ever be without!

avis.titre: Save your money for a retinoid cream or tretinoin
avis.texte: Of all the anti-aging products Clinique could launch, this one was odd and so bad. It's a very waxy texture — like cheap chapstick. Instead of melting in and hydrating luxuriously like other balms, it drags across skin. As others have noted, you get a small amount. I used it almost nightly around my eyes and on my slight 11s with no difference after the 5 weeks it lasted. Save your money!
I've been using this product for a few days and finally see that my stubborn wrinkles that where not going away are finally going away

avis.titre: More like a sample product than a full blown product to use
avis.texte: This runs out real quickly --- I do like the product but for the price should last longer - maybe make the tube longer? Just a suggestion--- LONG TIME CLINIQUE USER
After almost two weeks of using product I did not find any significant difference in wrinkles around my lips and eyes. However I did find a small difference in my forehead.
I love this product. I take it with me everywhere. So convenient! It smooths lines temporarily, but lasts for hours
I need a little more time to use the product to determine the results.

avis.titre: Erased fine lines, but lasts less than 3 weeks
avis.texte: This product is excellent. It immediately erases fine lines between my eyebrows, and on my forehead. I'm waiting to see if it helps deeper set wrinkles. I gave it only 4 stars because there is so little product. I can't get it to last even three weeks.

This Clinique retinoid balm works surprisingly quickly. I started to see improvement on my lines within a couple of weeks, especially on a vertical sleep line on my upper brow/forehead. I'm on my second tube, and about to buy a third. My big complaint is that the packaging forces you to dig out over a third (36 percent) of the included product with your pinkie or a Qtip. I measured my emptied tube and it holds 1.375 inches of product total but when it's fully twisted up, there's still .5 inches left inside! It's especially frustrating considering how pricey this is. I'll never not buy it on sale.

I have never smoked, but I have upper lip wrinkles. I started using this and I can't believe how much it has helped me. One side was worse than the other because of how I sleep. That side is much, much better, but the other side is almost gone. I hope you don't discontinue this product.

This product is very effective! Certain areas are more defined and have seen remarkable improvement. I can see where progress may not be apparent if the skin is not cleansed thoroughly and properly exfoliated. Using the serum and this product truly works wonders. And pressing the product gently and repeatedly is the key—when I didn't do this step the results were not as evident. A tube lasts quite awhile, but if I used it all over my face it would not.

I live how convenient it is and I l9ve putting it in the refrigerator on these warm days and how easy and nice to not have to put my fingers into it and I can use it as touch ups or more all over. I like as a touch up though the day. I wish it was bigger but the price is good also.

avis.titre: Great Retina Product for lips and eyes!
avis.texte: I just LOVE this Clinique Smart Clinical RetinaA anti aging product that is perfect for your lips and eyes! It makes them look younger after using it for a while because new skin develops. The product is not to strong it is just perfect. And it really does work! I highly recommend it!

avis.titre: This stuff is like magic in a purple tube
avis.texte: My forehead lines were pretty deep and this worked so well that after about three weeks I could barely see them anymore. I'm having a hard time seeing them when I try to apply it now. I definitely works and you won't be disappointed.

avis.titre: Too expensive for so little product
avis.texte: I've been using this for the last few weeks (3 weeks top, not even a month) and although I'm starting to see some improvements, I've already run out of the product. It did not even last a month. This is frustrating as I expect a product to last more and get a chance to fully appreciate it.

Wonderful product, especially for maturing dry eyes! I've had dry eyes my entire life, but really struggle now at the age of 62. This balm is so effective at locking in moisture & with little product required. Also, it has retinol! The best eye product Clinique has on the market for dry aging eyes!
I haven't notice any improvement from using this product and will not purchase again
I saw results using this product morning and evening. But then the tube only lasted 3 weeks! Using it in once a day I don't see the results I had. It's just expensive!

avis.titre: Great results in a convenient application
avis.texte: The stick is such an easy way to apply a retinoid! The balm-like consistency is soothing and easy to apply, also stays in place and absorbs quickly! Highly recommend and will likely continue to purchase!
Only lasted me anout a month until the product ran out. Id rather spend more to get more. I did enjoy the feel of it on my face just wasnt worth it and really didnt see any miraculous changes

I hesitate to write a good review because as soon as I fall in love with a product, Clinique tends to discontinue it, but here goes. This really works. I especially love using it around my eyes at night. It's made a dramatic difference in the crepey skin below my eyebrows. My eyes now look brighter, more lifted, and younger.

I bought this after doing some research on antiaging products, plus we've had many days of subzero temperatures here, and my skin is paying the price. I tried this balm, and it is exactly what it says - balm. It smooths and soothes my problem areas easily, is not thick, is not sticky, is colorless, odorless, and so handy in the twist up stick. I need one for my purse AND my makeup bag. Definitely buying again!
Great product. Not oily or thick. Perfect for those fine lines

avis.titre: Wow - great addition to my routine
avis.texte: I was skeptical at first. But after 6 weeks, I see a difference. I am a man with sensitive and very dry skin. I see a difference in the crow's feet and wrinkles around my eyes and temples. People have noticed that I look younger and my skin looks smoother. It is part of an overall routine with the right cleanser, serum, and moisturizer - and now this addition has made a visible difference. It is thick and stays on thick - so my dry skin quickly absorbs it. Men with oily skin may have a harder time with this one.
I'm super disappointed in this product. I have been using this for the last few months and I don't see any difference. The tube is very small and not much product for the price and doesn't last long.
I'm 47 and used this religiously and did not see any results.

I've been using this for a few days and I really like the way it feels on my skin. It hasn't been long enough to report results. I'm giving it 4 stars because it won't last long at all! Tube should be bigger for the price. Now if this turns out to be a miracle product then I take all that back. Even then I would want a larger tube and would pay a little more

I will repurchase this a million times!! I bought this in December to deminish neck lines. I have tried multiple products with no luck until this! I have noticed a huge improvement in my neck lines…they are almost completely gone! Amazing product!!! I cannot recommend this more!!! Seriously worth every penny!

I love this product that helps me reduce the appearance of the 11 between my brows and the frown lines around my mouth. I like the convenience of the packaging that allows the touch up at bedtime and before leaving the house for work or fun. I like that it is unscented.
This Retinoid Balm is part of my regular skincare regime. I have it on auto-ship. I would never go without using this product.

I've been using balm this along with the Clinique Smart Clinical Repair Wrinkle Correcting Face Cream. Both are fantastic. I love the ease of using the balm. I've been using it day and night and haven't had any irritation. I am seeing some improvement with reduction in fine lines.

A handy balm I bring with me when in a hurry (mornings). Easy swipe application. Does not leave any shine. It's the last step in my regimen before putting on make-up and before bed. Helps with fine lines. And did I mention it does not sting? Just wish a bigger size comes out soon.

I received this product for free through Influenster and ladies.... GET IT I'm honestly very happy I was selected for this product I haven't even been using it for a month yet and can already visibly see a difference especially in the corners on my eyes where I had some "crows feet" wrinkles.
Rolled it down when I got it and seemed like it was half gone already.
I wasn't expecting miracles, but was hoping it would help with the fine lines. I've used it twice a day for several weeks and see no difference

avis.titre: Excellent product - enjoyable to use, handy to carry
avis.texte: Such a little skin-saver in a stick form. Useful to have handy as needed. Only need to remember to apply SPF after using. Far prefer to have this as a spot-treatment for areas of concern, rather than be applying so many serums and creams all the time!

Wow, im on my mid 40's and have struggled with dry under eyes and wrinkles beginning to form. This stuff is the real deal! Ise it after your serums and before you moisturize on all of the areas that you are even beginning to get wrinkles, and you are going to he shocked at the results youll see after just a few uses. I love this stuff. It doesnt sry me out and its easy to apply. My skin looks so fresh!
I got severe allergic reaction from this peoduct. Extreme burn and ezcema under my eyes. Terrible product. Need to see Dr to help fix the massive rash under my eyes.

I love this little purple tube. Easy to apply, portable, great for travel or home. Gentle on my sensitive skin and easy to apply targeted areas. A little goes a long way. I never want to be without this product now that I've tried it.

This pleasant, neutral-scented product absorbed quickly, with easy, convenient application. It felt like a high-quality, smooth crème. I probably need to use it longer to fully access its effectiveness, but it seemed to reduce the signs of my crow's feet at the corners of my eyes. I would use it again!

This has been able to correct the fine lines in my forehead and face. I notice As i get Older that I'm starting to get fine lines and wrinkles. This product is so easy to use and so easy to apply. I love It and it's helped me feel more confident.

I love Clinique but, unfortunately this wasn't for me. I'm sure it works wonderful for some people but this made my eyes burn horribly. Not the outside corners of my eyes where I applied it, my actual eyes. I made sure not to put it too close to my eyes when testing this out. It felt fine at first then about 5 minutes later I noticed my eyes stinging. I don't have sensitive skin or eyes so this was unexpected. I hope this works for others but, I had to discontinue using the product.
It visibly corrects lines, also smooths the look of skin's textures, easy to apply

I love love love the packaging of this product. The fact that Clinique has created a retinol product that comes in the near form of a lip balm is so genius! I like using this product for targeted areas like my smile lines and forehead lines. It is quick and easy and I feel like the problem areas are getting a more concentrated dose of product and the rest of my face doesn't get as dried out as when I use a retinol cream all over.

I would recommend this for anyone looking for help blurring visible cracks and crevices. After one week of testing my free sample I saw a difference. The skin around my lips looked more taught, along with my frown lines. This product is now part of my daily routine.

If you travel this is a must! I'm traveling often so this compact stick is perfect for my toiletry bag. My skin can be sensitive to retinoids but I had no issues with the formula and could safely use it twice a day, even under my eyes where I'm most sensitive. I will say this is definitely not meant for your whole face, so I personally don't use it as my main whole-face retinoid. But it's perfect for targeting smaller areas/lines, so if you don't want whole/face or if you want a great travel retinoid I'd highly recommend!
Nice and compact. No scent at all. Leaves skin a tad sticky. Would definitely buy.

First off I Absolutely love the packaging, it's adorable and very effective and easy to use! You just use it like a lipstick, apply it to wrinkles, I rubbed it it. It has a good scent and feels nice and smooth! I used the CLINIQUE Smart clinical repair Am/PM retinoid balm for a few weeks and noticed a significant difference in my small wrinkles, thank you for this!

I received this product free to test and review. I can't say I really noticed any results in my fine lines or creases. I used it for a month every night, targeting my forehead and brow creases, but it just made my skin feel greasy (even the next morning). I have combination dry/normal skin regularly. It was easy to apply and didn't add much work to my regular skincare routine. The packaging is attractive and compact.

Product is so easy to apply! No strong scent which is nice. Easy to store and use. Can't comment on effectiveness just yet since products like this take a long time to see change, but I do love the feel on my skin.
I wanted to like this so much. But it fell short. I used it for a month and it just made my skin feel greasy

First off, thank you, Influensters, for the free gift in exchange for a review. I absolutely love the vibrant purple color of the tube it's both eye-catching and appealing. The packaging is also a cute, soft green that feels very secure and safe for the product. The compact size is perfect for travel, fitting easily into my purse without taking up much space. As for the texture, it feels incredibly moisturizing, almost like Vaseline but much smoother, which I really enjoyed. The absorption is a bit oily but not too overwhelming—it leaves a slight sheen, which some may appreciate. Another aspect I appreciated is that the product is scentless. Sometimes, scents can be overwhelming or unpleasant, and in some cases, they can even trigger reactions on sensitive skin. So, the lack of fragrance was a definite plus for me. When it comes to effectiveness, I noticed a slight improvement in my skin. It definitely kept my skin smooth, but I didn't see a significant difference in the appearance of wrinkles. While there was some change, it wasn't as much as I had hoped for. Overall, I did like the product, especially for its moisturizing qualities, the secure packaging, and the fact that it's scentless. However, I feel the price is a bit steep considering the minimal results I saw regarding wrinkle reduction. If it were more affordable, I might consider purchasing it for the moisturization alone. But for those who don't mind spending a little extra and are looking for hydration with some n

I'm absolutely loving the Clinique Retinol Balm! It's been a game-changer for my skin. The convenience of this product is unbeatable. The texture is divine, feeling luxurious and moisturizing without any greasiness. Plus, it's fragrance-free, which is a huge win for my sensitive skin. I've noticed a significant reduction in wrinkles and fine lines after just a month of use. It's amazing to have a product that delivers results without requiring a lengthy skincare routine. I've already made it a staple in my routine.

I am so in love with this Clinical Repair AM/PM Retinoid Balm!! I've been using this for quite some time now too and I can see such an improvement in the quality of my skin. There is no strong scent, I find the product to be just what I needed! I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review.

I personally don't notice any difference in my skin or fine lines. I do have a small fine line next to my smile line and it's not too noticeable and I assumed this would help it disappear but I don't notice a difference. It is however very easy to use and feels nice on the skin. It's more of an oily texture so do what you will with that info.

So I've only been using this product for a month, and I will say I am seeing slow results with diminishing fine lines. They aren't completely gone, but they are lighter. I love the compact and easy to apply tube and it's easy to travel with. Just like a lipstick tube you remove cap, apply and go!

avis.titre: Easy to use and helps my lines
avis.texte: This was the first balm type retinol I've used and found it easy to use! It was nice to have a stick type application. Not sure if I saw a difference in my fine lines but I did like the way it feels!

I got this on a whim, not thinking much of it. I'm glad I did. I've been using the balm day and night and I can see some decent improvements in my forehead and in my smile lines. I've been using it for two weeks now.

I'm not so much familiar with Clinique skin care products besides one of my favorite clearing gel. About this Retinoid balm I was using.. I did not see any difference too much so far. I think I will have to go thru the product to actually see the difference if any. I'm not a fan of the purple packaging to be honest. But I really like the balmy texture. It's super easy to use, doesn't do any mess, doesn't irritate my skin and the application is very smooth. Doesn't have any fragrance. I'm giving 3* because the product is really easy to use (you don't have to touch the product) so you can use it basically on the go if you need to. I just didn't see the difference YET!
What a wonderful product it get you a plump soft sensation, long lasting and super make up friendly

Clinique's retenoid balm is mildly scented and has the consistency of a lip balm. It's too thick for the fine lines around my eyes but has minimized the wrinkles on my neck. It works well on those, and the lip balm-type tube makes it simple to apply. I will likely buy more when this runs out.

I received this free from Influenster for an honest review. I used this for 3 weeks around my lips and eyes and did not notice my fine lines changing but it did make my skin smoother. There is no scent and it glides on very easily.

I received this product for free from influenster and Clinique in exchange for my honest review. So I'm 27, with very sensitive skin. This retinol balm stick did not irritate my skin or cause any burning by my eyes when I applied under my eyes. So that's a huge plus. This absorbed well for me, it stays balmy for a while but my skin soaks it in which I really like. As far as effectiveness.. I haven't noticed any difference, but it's possible I haven't used it long enough. I use tretinoin once a week so I use this twice a week as well. This also has no scent at all.

avis.titre: Sold out and theres a reason why!
avis.texte: Compact skincare is soooo cool. Helps move around and bring with me. The difference is crazy I love it. And def worth the try. It's sold out but if you can find it try it!

avis.titre: under eyes look so much better LOVE THIS
avis.texte: at first, I was skeptical about this product because I have used a lot of products to help deal with my under eyes and the puffiness along with the under eye circles and even wrinkles and I haven't found a product that works till I found. Clinique Smart clinical repair. My under eyes looks so much better. They're smoother and all I needed to do was apply it once in the a.m. and once in the p.m..

I received the Smart Repair AM/PM Retinoid Balm for free from Clinique and Influenster. I really like that the balm comes in a convenient small applicator similar to a lip stick. It has no scent. I love that the retinoid balm is so gentle on my skin and doesn't dry it out.

I received the Clinique Smart Clinical Repair AM/PM Retinoid Balm for free from Influenster in exchange for my honest review. This balm comes in a lightweight purple metallic tube. It is unscented and has a smooth texture that melts and absorbs easily when applied. It is moisturizing without feeling heavy on your skin. I mostly used this balm around my eyes and on my smile lines, and it does seem to have made a slight difference. I think this product would work best for someone with a more minimal skincare routine, as the moisturizing effect will be more pronounced.
Skin feels good after using this product. I was using it for fine lines and I think it worked. My recommendation.

I received this product in exchange for my honest review from Influenster. Clinique's Smart Repair balm has been a great addition to my nighttime skincare routine. I love the packaging, very easy to apply, with noticeable results after only a few weeks. I use it around my lips, and my forehead lines. Plumps and hydrates with no discernible scent or irritation. Definitely will purchase after I run out!

I I am usually allergic with all the retinol and retinoids, but this one is so nice and small. It does not give me any hives or any allergic reaction Eczema. I am so in love with this Balm, Because it just glides on my skin, I use mostly underneath my eyes and on my Smile lines. I see a drastic change in my skin because I have very creepy skin underneath my eyes and very deep wrinkles on the side of my mouth/smile lines, but this helped me get rid of the swelling underneath my eyes lessen the appearance of my lines. I got the product from influencer for an honest reveal. It took me one month to post the review because I don't want to miss guide or anything about the product. I love all products though I'm a huge fan.

avis.titre: Definitely diminishes fine lines and wrinkles.
avis.texte: I received this product for free from Influenster for my honest opinion. This balm goes on smooth and really doesn't have a scent. The packaging is compact and easily carried in my purse or bag. This product really lessened my wrinkles and made quite the difference on my face. I look and feel younger. All in all, I would purchase this product in the future.

I've never tried a retinol stick before and was pleasantly surprised. It is fragrance free and although it is recommended to use twice a day, I use something heavier every few evenings, so I've been using this around the fine lines around my mouth, eyes and forehead in the morning. I feel it adds a plumping and moisturizing effect and I'm excited to see what will happen over time with continued usage. I always make sure to use SPF every single day, which is critical when using any kind of retinol product.

I received this product in exchange for my honest review from influenster. I really liked that it was super easy to use and mess free. The applicator looks like a lipstick and it's very easy and comfortable to hold. It's easy to control the amount of product and where I'm applying it. I mostly use it at night and I wear sunscreen as recommended. It did not irritate my skin or bring on any breakouts. I have been using it for about 3 weeks and I can definitely notice a difference. Definitely would recommend!

The convenience of putting this on is everything! A quick swipe where you need it and you're on your way. Lipstick style container so you turn as you go to raise the balm. Unscented and smooth. Highly recommend. Easy to use and super effective!
I'm absolutely loving this repair balm! It's so easy to use; just pop off the cap and swipe on. It really softens the look of fine lines. Makes my skin look fantastic!

avis.titre: Makes a great addition to my retinol arsenal
avis.texte: I was a little skeptical at first of this. I figured anything wearable during the day would most likely not be strong enough to be very effective. I've been pleasantly surprised. I do see improvement and will be buying more when needed. I will add my crows feet, smile lines, etc aren't really deep so someone older than my almost 50 years or with more sun exposure in their youth might not see as good as results. I'd say it's a great tool stand alone for those in their 30s & young 40s. And a nice addition to our regular retinol regimen for anyone older!

avis.titre: Does what it is supposed to do!
avis.texte: I was given this product in exchange for my fair and honest review. Clinique has always been a trusted brand. This Smart Clinical Repair AM/PM Retinoid Balm is pretty great stuff. It really did reduce my fine lines around my eyes. The pictures I posted are proof of that. I didn't really have the forehead wrinkles, so I used it where you would be able to tell the most difference. I used for one month. There is no scent, that I could smell. My only issue would be that it was kind of greasy, and took a bit to absorb so that I could apply makeup. The cost is fairly reasonable, and I would say one tube would last a few months. Would recommend this product, but be aware that it is a bit greasy.

I realize it slightly fill up my lines after few weeks, a big surprise for this little product. I use it after basic skincare steps and especially in morning wakeup with the plumped up and moisture fine lines. Just only one thing I'm not really enjoy which's a sticky formulation, sometimes it makes me feel my skin's getting oily.

avis.titre: Soften the lines around my eyes
avis.texte: I received this product free for the exchange of my honest review on behalf of Influenster. I have used this consistently twice a day and have noticed the lines around my eyes have soften and are not as visible as before I plan to include this as part of my skin routine and recommend this product to those that need an over the counter retinoid. It is easy to use and is more like a balm and apply a smoothly. And it provides a great moisturizer around the eyes.

This product is easy to use, no mess on hands. I apply it like chapstick. I haven't noticed much improvement on my fine lines. Hopefully it works to prevent any future ones! I received this product in exchange for my honest review.

I received this product in exchange for my honest review from influenster. It's very easy to use and comes in a purple lipstick like applicator. I feel my lines were reduced making this product great for a night out, work or any time. Use in morning and evening. I wear sunscreen as recommended. Its helped my dry skin feel better.

avis.titre: I like the precision of where I want it to go .
avis.texte: I received this product from Influenster free for my honest review . I have used Clinique for a few years now and love their products. I like the precision of this balm . I can put it where I need to . No greasy feel. No odor. I use before I put my moisturizer on. I have been using for about a month and haven't seen a major difference yet, but I will continue using as with most products it takes time. Clinique hasn't failed me yet. I would recommend.

This Clinique AM/PM Retinoid Balm is really easy to use. The stick is convenient so you don't have to get it on your hands. I've used it a couple days a week for a couple weeks now on my forehead & crows feet. I don't notice much difference in my wrinkles. Around my eyes is really tender and red now. I have sensitive skin. There is no smell. It's tacky when you put it on but it absorbs.
Clinique Smart Clinical Repair AM/PM Retinoid Balm glides effortlessly and smoothly during application. It provides noticeable results. I received this product for free as part of a promotion.

After just one day of using this retinol eye stick, I noticed a brightness under my eyes and less dark circles. I really feel like it's nourishing my skin and preventing future wrinkles. The seller also reached out to be both before purchase to provide me with instructions on how to use it as well as after to check on how I was liking it. I highly recommend this product!

I get the product for stars because I do believe it is small amount for the price. I've been using it for a while and I do feel like my lines have decreased, but not as much as I was using a retinoid from a dermatologist a good product if you don't want to use the real thing. I received this product complementary for my honest review

I love this! It is a standard balm similar to chapstick. The component is so beautiful and vibrant with the purple metallic. Easy to find what you are looking for. Fragrance free. It is so perfect to add the extra amount to more problem areas you may have. I don't have a lot of crow's feet, but my smile lines are out of control. This really did help them!
